full_judgment: 5. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, the learned Advocate appearing for the plaintiff-opposite-party, on the other hand, finds it difficult to support the impugned order and submits that the plaintiff-opposite-party is litigating since 1965 and the matter being dragged since then on this plea or that plea and in that view of the matter it would be just and proper if a direction is given to the trial Court to dispose of the suit within 6 months from the date of receipt of the order of this court.
